title: Fast-tier tests rewrite docs/REGISTRY.yaml and working_log.csv, and consolidate live monitoring shards
summary: Isolated the one unisolated test that regenerated the real docs/REGISTRY.yaml on every run, deleted a redundant subprocess test, added a module-scoped regression guard to both files, and disproved the ticket's own second hypothesis (traced the real shard-consolidation mechanism to a different file, filed as a sibling ticket).

title: done_checker_static CLI gives false FAILs after closure and blames sibling tickets' docs
summary: Fixed the CLI's --part default to skip precheck for an already-closed ticket (with an explanatory note), and made the reverse docs_to_update_coverage check exclude docs/REGISTRY.yaml unconditionally and drop sibling-claimed uncommitted docs paths from the same batch.
